discussion_comments.comment_body:
🟠 **Dependency floors diverge from the monorepo.** `fastmcp>=0.1.0` is dangerously loose — sibling servers pin `>=2.13.x`, and `>=0.1.0` permits resolving an API-incompatible ancient release. Also `pytest>=9.0.0` (line 18) has no stable release; siblings use `>=7.4.0`. Consider also adding the standard `authors`, `[project.urls]`, `classifiers`, `[tool.ruff.lint]`, `[tool.pyright]` sections other servers carry.

```suggestion
    "fastmcp>=2.13.1",
```

Separately: `server.py` never calls `logger.remove()`/`logger.add(sys.stderr, level=os.getenv('FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL', ...))`, so the `FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL` env var advertised in the README has no effect. Sibling servers configure loguru at import — worth matching.
